name: Scholarship to Meritorious students possessing Mathematics /Physics.
description: Sanction Set-100 (Maths 50 and Physics 50) Students admited for science graduation and having maths or physics as a main subject are eligible to apply this schoalrship. For Fresh - Candidate must secure 60 Percentage in 12th standard. He is not awarded any other scholarshiop of State & Central Governement. candidate must be resident of Maharashtra State. 6. New sanction process done through DHE office and Renewal sanction process done through joint director office of concern colleges. Selection of Candidates Is on Merit basis
